answer: Think of Notary signature on a declaration as a toll booth: a declaration signed before a notary, so the zenith of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Honest agents already carry what Notary signature on a declaration asks for, so they pass without noticing; the ocean is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the meadow is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
